name: Selling freelance service 'gigs' on Fiverr
summary: List fixed-price service packages ('gigs') that buyers can order directly; Fiverr keeps 20% of each sale.
whatYouDo: You create gig listings that describe a specific service, with price tiers and delivery times. Buyers find and order your gig, you deliver the work through Fiverr's order system, and your earnings clear to your balance after a holding period.
appeal: Buyers find you through search instead of you bidding on jobs
Simple flat fee: you keep 80% of each order
Faster 7-day clearance and early payout become available at higher seller levels or with Seller Plus
watchOuts: Fiverr keeps 20% of every order, including tips
Standard sellers' earnings are held for 14 days after an order completes before you can withdraw
Early payout costs 1% and is limited to Top Rated sellers and Seller Plus Premium members
Buyers also pay a 5.5% service fee (plus $3.50 on orders under $200), which makes your gig cost them more
Fiverr Community posts report sudden drops in gig impressions and accounts disabled after several order cancellations
Canada-specific payout methods and fees weren't confirmed in this check

compensation.notes: You set your gig prices. No earnings data was checked. You receive 80% of the order value after any discounts.

reliability.notes: Orders depend on how your gigs rank in search. Fiverr Community anecdotes describe sudden impression drops and long gaps with no orders.

fees: 20% commission on every order, tips included. Earnings clear after 14 days (7 days for Seller Plus, Top Rated and Pro). Early payout costs 1%. Withdrawal-method fees vary and weren't confirmed for Canada.
applicationSteps: Create a seller account and profile
Publish gigs with clear packages, prices and delivery times
Deliver orders on time and avoid cancellations, which can hurt your ranking
Withdraw cleared revenue through an available payout method
fitsIf: You can package a clear, repeatable service and can wait while your gigs build reviews and ranking.
notFitIf: You need quick, predictable income or can't absorb a 20% commission.

sources.title: Growth Tools for Seller Plus
sources.notes: From a search summary: the seller's revenue is 80% of the order amount after any discount. Direct fetch was blocked.

sources.title: Early Payout
sources.notes: From a search summary of Fiverr help pages (attribution approximate): standard clearance is 14 days, or 7 days for Seller Plus, Top Rated and Pro. Early payout is for Top Rated sellers and Seller Plus Premium members and costs 1% each time. Direct fetch was blocked.

sources.title: Paying for orders, extras, or custom offers
sources.notes: From a search summary: buyers pay a 5.5% service fee, plus $3.50 on orders under $200. Direct fetch was blocked.

sources.title: Fiverr Seller Fees 2026: The Official Complete Guide for Freelancers — FreelancerCalculator.com
sources.notes: A third-party guide, not an official Fiverr page despite its title. It says Fiverr takes a flat 20% including tips and holds earnings 14 days, and that withdrawal fees vary by method (PayPal, bank, Payoneer). It doesn't cover Canada.

sources.title: Fiverr accounts are empty of orders and impressions have dropped drastically
sources.notes: Seller anecdotes about sharp drops in impressions and long stretches without orders, sometimes after a cancelled order.

sources.title: Account disable issue
sources.notes: Anecdotes (attribution approximate): accounts disabled after several order cancellations, including one that still had orders in progress.
